svg.aria-label: Load and store queues, what an entry goes through
svg.text: Load and store queues, what an entry goes through
Two banks per queue, one LDP that becomes two requests, accesses that straddle a line or a page, the load that never reaches the cache, and three predictors the M1 does not have.
One LDP, one or two cache requests
Zero-cycle load, the store value is renamed in
A load behind a failed pointer check
x absent, measured; the first two arrive on M2 and M3
stores: one contiguous run per bank
SQ entry: base x2, data P7
no TLB fill, no cache fill
